title: Review pages: find each sound
kaylee: Nothing changes for Kaylee. On review pages, each sound now shows its start and end time, the one playing lights up, and tapping a sound plays it. Try it on the Nan road below.

items.text: engine: Steady engine hum of a small SUV heard from inside the cabin (loop)
scooter: small motor scooter putters past on a quiet country road
tuktuk: Thai tuk-tuk three-wheeler drives past
songthaew: small pickup truck taxi drives past on a country road
car: small car drives past on a country road
honk: single honk of a real pickup truck horn
honk-tune: Three short rhythmic taps on a real pickup truck horn
moo: water buffalo gives one long
cluck: few chickens clucking
monkey: small monkey chattering playfully
rail: Cartoon rubber bumper boing
rain-roof: Gentle rain pattering on a car roof heard from inside the car (loop)
wet-tyres: Car tyres hissing on a wet road (loop)
cloud-in: Soft airy whoosh of driving into a thick cloud of fog
screech: Cartoon tyre squeal as a small car swerves round a corner
wiper: windscreen wiper sweeping once across a wet windshield
wiper-dry: windscreen wiper squeaking once across a dry windshield
puddle: car driving through a big puddle
squeak: squeaky rubber toy elephant squeezed
country: Peaceful countryside in the green hills of northern Thailand (loop)
town: calm small-town street in northern Thailand (loop)
